षातिन्: षातिन् mfn. (-ती-तिनी-ति) Going, going to, alighting, falling, pouring forth.  E. पत् to go, घिणुन् aff.
ष: ष The thirty-first consonant of the Nāgari alphabet, and second sibilant, corresponding to Sh, pronounced in some schools Kh: this letter is usually the first element of the roots, the derivatives of which commence with स ।

ष mfn. (-षः-षा-षं) Best, excellent. 	 m. (-षः) 	 1. A learned man, a teacher. 2. A nipple. 	 3. Loss, destruction. 	 4. Rest, remainder. 	 5. Loss of knowledge, previously acquired. 	 6. Eternal happiness, final eman-cipation. 	 7. Heaven, paradise. 	 8. Sleep. 	 9. End, term. 	 10. Hair. n. (-षं) 	 1. The embryo. 	 2. Patience, endurance.  E. षो to destroy, &c., aff. कं or ड and the consonant unchanged, &c.
षग्: षग्(ए)षगे r. 1st cl. (सगति) To cover: also written सग् ।
षघ्: षघ्(ए)षघे r. 5th cl. (सघ्नोति) To hurt or kill: also सघ् ।
षच्: षच् r. 1st cl. (सचते) 	 1. To wet, to moisten, to sprinkle. 	 2. To serve, to gratify by service. (सचति) 	 1. To be connected. 	 2. To understand thoroughly.
षञ्ज्: षञ्ज् r. 1st cl. (सजति) To embrace, to cling or adhere to, to be in con-tact or connexion with. With अव prefixed, To hang down from, to be suspended. With वि and आङ्, To struggle together. With आङ्, To be attached or devoted to. (उ) षञ्जु r. 2st cl. (सञ्जति-ते) To go.
षट्: षट् r. 1st cl. (षटति) To be a part or portion.
षट्क: षट्क mfn. (-ट्कः-ट्का-ट्कं) 	 1. Six. 	 2. Having six-fold, &c. 	 n. (-ट्कं) An aggregate of six.  E. षष् six, and कन् poss. aff.
षट्कर्ण: षट्कर्ण m. (-र्णः) A sort of lute. Adj. Heard by six ears, i. e. by three persons.  E. षष् six, and कर्ण an ear.
षट्कर्मन्: षट्कर्म्मन् m. (-र्म्मा) 	 1. A Brāhman. 	 2. An adept, (in the Tantras, &c.) 	 n. (-र्म्म or pl. -र्म्माणि) 	 1. The six acts proper for a Brāhman, (collective-ly,) or teaching the Vedas, holy study, offering sacrifices, conduct-ing them for others, giving, and accepting gifts. 	 2. Six acts allow-able to a Brāhman for subsistence, or gleaning, accepting gifts, ask-ing alms, agriculture, trade, and tending cattle, or according to some lending money at interest. 	 3. The six acts taught in the Tantras, or killing, infatuating, enthralling, expelling, exciting animosity, and the stopping or privation of any faculty.  E. षष् six, कर्म्मन् act or duty.
षट्कर्म्मन्: षट्कर्म्मन् m. (-र्म्मा) 	 1. A Brāhman. 	 2. An adept, (in the Tantras, &c.) 	 n. (-र्म्म or pl. -र्म्माणि) 	 1. The six acts proper for a Brāhman, (collective-ly,) or teaching the Vedas, holy study, offering sacrifices, conduct-ing them for others, giving, and accepting gifts. 	 2. Six acts allow-able to a Brāhman for subsistence, or gleaning, accepting gifts, ask-ing alms, agriculture, trade, and tending cattle, or according to some lending money at interest. 	 3. The six acts taught in the Tantras, or killing, infatuating, enthralling, expelling, exciting animosity, and the stopping or privation of any faculty.  E. षष् six, कर्म्मन् act or duty.
षट्कोण: षट्कोण n. (-णं) 	 1. A hexagon, a six-angled figure. 	 2. The thunderbolt of INDRA.  E. षष् six, कोण a corner.
षट्चक्र: षट्चक्र n. (-क्रं) The six mystical circles of the body, (in Tantra.)
षट्चरण: षट्चरण m. (-णः) 	 1. A bee, 2. A louse. 	 3. A locust.  E. षट् six, चरण a foot.
षट्ट्: षट्ट् r. 10th cl. (सट्टयति-ते) 	 1. To injure, to hurt or kill. 	 2. To give. 	 3. To be strong. 	 4. To dwell.
षट्त्रिंशत्: षट्त्रिंशत् f. (-शत्) 	 1. Thirty-six. 	 2. A work on law.  E. षष् six, and त्रिंशत् thirty.
षट्पद: षट्पद m. (-दः) A bee. 	 mf. (-दः-दी) A louse. 	 f. (-दी) 	 1. A louse. 	 2. A female bee. 	 3. A stanza consisting of six lines.  E. षष् six, पद a foot.
षट्पदप्रिय: षट्पदप्रिय m. (-यः) The Nāgeshwar, (Mesue ferrea.)  E. षट्पद a bee, and प्रिय beloved by; equally applicable therefore to the lotus, jas-mine, &c.
षट्पदातिथि: षट्पदातिथि m. (-थिः) 	 1. The mango-tree. 	 2. The Champaka.  E. षट्पद a bee, अतिथि a guest.
षट्प्रज्ञ: षट्प्रज्ञ m. (-ज्ञः) 	 1. A sage, one acquainted with the four objects of human existence, or virtue, wealth, desire, and final happiness, and with the nature of the world, and of divine truth. 	 2. A catamite. E. षष् six, and प्रज्ञ who knows.
षडक्षीण: षडक्षीण m. (-णः) A fish.  E. षष् six, and अक्षि the eye, ख aff.
षडङ्ग: षडङ्ग mfn. (-ङ्गः-ङ्गी-ङ्गं) 	 1. Having six limbs or members. 	 2. Having six parts, six ingredients, &c. 	 n. (-ङ्गं) 	 1. Six parts of the body collec-tively; as the two arms, two legs, and the head and waist. 	 2. The six supplementary parts of the Vedas or grammar, prosody, astronomy, pronunciation, the meaning of unusual terms, and the ritual of the Hindu religion.  E. षष् six, and अङ्ग a limb or part.
षडङ्गजित्: षडङ्गजित् m. (-जित्) VISHṆU.  E. षडङ्ग the six members, जित् who subdues.
षडङ्गपानीय: षडङ्गपानीय n. (-यं) An infusion or decoction of six drugs.  E. षडङ्ग, and पानीय drink.
षडङ्घ्रि: षडङ्घ्रि m. (-ङ्घ्रिः) A bee.  E. षष् six, and अङ्घ्रि a foot.
षडभिज्ञ: षडभिज्ञ m. (-ज्ञः) A Buddha or Bauddha deified sage.  E. षष् six, (branches of learning or piety,) and अभिज्ञ understanding.
षडानन: षडानन m. (-नः) KĀRTIKEYA.  E. षष् six, and आनन a face; having six faces, four directed to the four cardinal points, and two to the zenith and nadir, according to some accounts, though not gener-ally so represented.
षडूषण: षडूषण n. (-णं) Six spices collectively, or long-pepper, black-pepper, dried ginger, the root of long-pepper, the fruit of the plumbago, and of the Piper chavya.  E. षष् six, and ऊषण a spice.
षडृतु: षडृतु m. Plur. (-तवः) The six seasons; also personified as divinities. E. षष्, and ऋतु a season.
षङ्गव: षङ्गव n. (-वं) A yoke of six oxen or six oxen collectively.  E. षष् six, गो an ox, अच् added.
षड्गुण: षड्गुण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) Six-fold, six times. 	 n. (-णं) An assemblage, of six qualities or properties. 	 mf. (-णः-णा) The six acts of a king in his military character, viz. “सन्धि” alliance, “विग्रह” war, “यान” march, “स्थान” halt, “आसन” strategem, and “द्वैधीभाव” aid of other kings.  E. षष् and गुण a time.
षड्ग्रन्थ: षड्ग्रन्थ n. (-न्थः) A variety of the Cæsalpinia bonducella. 	 f. (-न्था) Orris root, (Acorus calamus.)  E. षष् six, ग्रन्थि a knot.
षड्ग्रन्थिका: षड्ग्रन्थिका f. (-का) Zedoara, (Curcuma zerumbet.)  E. षड्ग्रन्थ as above, कन् added.
षड्ज: षड्ज m. (-ड्जः) The first of the seven primary notes in music.  E. षष् six, ज born: supposed to require for its articulation the employ-ment of the tongue, teeth, palate, nose, throat, and chest.
षड्दर्शन: षड्दर्शन n. (-नं) The six systems of philosophy taken together.
षड्धा: षड्धा Ind. In six ways.  E. षष् six, and धाच् aff.
षड्भाग: षड्भाग m. (-गः) A sixth, a sixth part.  E. षष्, and भाग share.
षड्भागभाज्: षड्भागभाज् mfn. (-भाक्) Entitled to a sixth.  E. षड्भाग, भाज् who shares.
षड्भुज: षड्भुज mfn. (-जः-जा-जं) Six armed, six-sided. 	 m. (-जः) A hexagon. 	 f. (-जा) The water-melon. “खरमुज.”  E. षष् six, भुज an arm or branch, &c., aff. टाप्.
षड्रस: षड्रस n. (-सं) The six flavours collectively.
षड्रेखा: षड्रेखा f. (-खा) A water-melon.  E. षष् six, and रेखा a line.
षड्वर्ग: षड्वर्ग m. (-र्गः) A class or aggregate of six, as of six defects or enemies of humanity taken together. viz:--“काम” desire, “क्रोध” wrath, “लोभ” covetousness, “मोह” bewilderment, “मद” pride, and “मात्मर्य्य” envy.  E. षष् six, and वर्ग a class.
षड्वर्गवश्य: षड्वर्गवश्य mfn. (-श्यः-श्या-श्यं) Subject to the six vices.  E. षड्वर्ग, वश्य to be subjected.
षड्विध: षड्विध mfn. (-धः-धा-धं) In six ways, of six kinds.  E. षष्, and विध kind.
षड्विन्दु: षड्विन्दु m. (-न्दुः) VISHṆU.  E. षष् six, and विन्दु a drop or spot.
षण्: षण्(उ)षणु r. 8th cl. (सनोति सनुते) 	 1. To give. 	 2. To serve or honour; also written षन् ।
षण्ड: षण्ड m. (-ण्डः) 	 1. A bull at liberty. 	 2. A eunuch. 	 3. A multitude, a heap. 	 mn. (-ण्डः-ण्डं) A quantity of lotuses.  E. षण् to give, ड Unādi aff.; also शण्ड, षण्ढ, and शण्ढ, &c.
षण्डाली: षण्डाली f. (-ली) 	 1. A measure of oil, the vessel holding a Chhatāk. 	 2. A wanton woman. 	 3. A pond, a pool.  E. षण्ड a bull, a eunuch, &c., and अल् to be able, affs. अच् and ङीप् ।
षण्ढ: षण्ढ m. (-ण्ढः) A eunuch: see षण्ड ।
षण्मास: षण्मास m. (-सः) A half year, six months.  E. षष्, and मास a month.
षण्मास्य: षण्मास्य mfn. (-स्यः-स्या-स्यं) Six month old, of six months standing, &c. E. षण्मास and यत् aff.; also षाण्मास्य ।
षण्मुख: षण्मुख m. (-खः) KĀRTIKEYA. 	 f. (-खा) A water-melon.  E. षष् six, मुख face.
षत्वणत्व: षत्वणत्व n. (-त्वं) The substitution of the letters ष or ण for स and न in grammatical derivatives,  E. ष and ण the letters, with the abstract affix attached to each respectively.
षद्: षद्(औ ऌ)औषदॢ r. 1st and 6th cls. (सीदति) 	 1. To wither, to wane, to perish gradually. 	 2. To be low-spirited, to despond, to be wearied or distressed, to lack energy. 	 3. To break or destroy. 	 4. To go or move. With आङ् prefixed, आषदॢ r. 1st and 10th cls. (आसादति आसादयति-ते) 1. To go. 	 2. To assail, to encounter. With अव prefixed, 1. To be exhausted or languid. 	 2. To finish. With आङ्, 1. To obtain, to attain, to reach or arrive at. 	 2. To attack. With उत्, 1. To ascend. 2. To destroy. With उप, 1. To approach. 	 2. To worship. With नि, 1. To sit in or on. 	 2. To stand. 	 3. To protect. With प्र, 1. To be propitious to, to favour or be pleased with. 	 2. To please or pro-pitiate. 	 3. To purify. 	 4. To smile. With वि, To be languid or sorrow-ful. With सम्, 1. To attain. 	 2. To be in company or society with.
षध्: षध् r. 5th cl. (सध्नोति) To wish to hurt or kill.
षन्: षन्(उ)षनु r. 8th cl. (सनोति सनुते) To give; also षण् ।
षप्: षप् r. 1st. cl. (सपति) 	 1. To be connected. 	 2. To understand thoroughly.
षम्: षम् r. 1st cl. (समति) 	 1. To be unconfused. 	 2. To be confused. r. 10th cl. (समयति-ते) To perplex or distress.
षम्ब्: षम्ब् r. 1st cl. (सम्बति) To go, to move. r. 10th cl. (सम्बयति-ते) To unite, to join, to collect or assemble together; also read सम्ब् ।
षर्ज्ज्: षर्ज्ज् r. 1st cl. (सर्ज्जति) To earn, to acquire.
षर्व: षर्व r. 1st cl. (सर्वति) 	 1. To go, to move. 	 2. To injure, to hurt; also read सर्व् ।
षल्: षल् r. 1st cl. (सलति) 	 1. To go, to move. 	 2. To shake.
षष्: षष् mfn. Plu. only (षट् or षड्) Six.
षष्टि: षष्टि f. (-ष्टिः) Sixty.  E. षष् six, डटि aff.
षष्टिक: षष्टिक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Bought with sixty. 	 mf. (-कः-का) A kind of rice of quick growth.  E. षष् six, (days,) ठन् aff.; or षष्टि sixty, and कन् added.
षष्टिक्य: षष्टिक्य mfn. (-क्यः-क्या-क्यं) Fit for rice of quick growth, (a field, &c.)  E. षष्टिक, and यत् aff.
षष्टितम: षष्टितम mfn. (-मः-मी-मं) Sixtieth.  E. षष्टि sixty, and तमप् aff.
षष्टिधा: षष्टिधा Ind. In sixty ways.  E. षष्टि sixty, and धा aff.
षष्टिमत्त: षष्टिमत्त m. (-त्तः) An elephant who has reached the age of sixty and is in rut.  E. षष्टि sixty, मत्त furious.
षष्टियोजनी: षष्टियोजनी f. (-नी) A journey or extent of sixty YOJANAS.
षष्टिहायन: षष्टिहायन m. (-नः) 	 1. An elephant sixty years old. 	 2. A kind of rice. E. षष्टि, हायन a year.
षष्ठ: षष्ठ mfn. (-ष्ठः-ष्ठी-ष्ठं) Sixth. 	 f. (-ष्ठी) 	 1. DURGĀ as one of the sixteen divine mothers. 	 2. The sixth day of the lunar fortnight. 	 3. The sixth or genetive case, (in gram.)  E. षष् six, डति aff., थुक् aug.
षष्ठक: षष्ठक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Sixth.  E. कन् added to the last.
षष्ठांश: षष्ठांश m. (-शः) 	 1. The sixth part of agricultural produce taken by the sovereign from the subject in the shape of a land-tax. 	 2. A sixth part in general.
षष्ठान्न: षष्ठान्न n. (-न्नं) A sixth meal.  E. षष्ठ, and अन्न food.
षष्ठान्नकाल: षष्ठान्नकाल n. (-लं) The taking of food once in three days, as an act of penance.  E. षष्ठान्न, and काल time; also with कन् added, षष्ठान्नकालकं ।
षष्ठान्नकालता: षष्ठान्नकालता f. (-ता) Eating once in three days, on the evening of the third day.  E. षष्ठान्नकाल, and तल् aff.
षष्ठिन्: षष्ठिन् mfn. (-ष्ठी-ष्ठिनी-ष्ठि) Being or having the sixth, (year, &c.)  E. षष्ठ, इनि poss. aff.

षष्ठीपूजा: षष्ठीपूजा f. (-जा) The worship of the goddess DURGĀ, as one of the sixteen divine mothers, on the sixth day after the delivery of a woman.
षस्ज्: षस्ज् r. 1st cl. (सज्जति) To move, to go.
षह्: षह् r. 1st cl. (सहते) r. 4th cl. (सह्मति) r. 10th cl. (साहयति-ते) 1. To bear, to endure, to suffer or support, to forbear, to have patience. 	 2. To be content or satisfied. 	 3. To be able. With उत् prefixed, 1. To make effort or exertion, to persevere, to energize. 2. To be happy or delighted. With प्र, To be violent. With वि, To determine.
षहसानु: षहसानु m. (-नुः) 	 1. A peacock. 	 2. A sacrifice.
षाट्: षाट् Ind. An interjection of calling.
षाट्कौशिक: षाट्कौशिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Enveloped in six sheathes.  E. षट्, कोश a sheath, ठक् aff.
षाड्व: षाड्व m. (-वः) 	 1. Sentiment, passion. 	 2. Singing, music. 	 3. A Rāga in which six of the seven primary notes are used, (in music.)
षाड्गुण्य: षाड्गुण्य n. (-ण्यं) 	 1. An aggregate of six properties or qualities. 	 2. The six acts of royal military policy. 	 3. Multiplication of anything by six.  E. षड्गुण, and ष्यञ् aff.
षाण्मातुर: षाण्मातुर m. (-रः) KĀRTIKEYA.  E. षष् six, and मातृ a mother, अण् aff.; having been brought up by the six Kirtikās.
षाण्मासिक: षाण्मासिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Of or relating to six months, half yearly, &c.  E. षण्मास, and ढञ् aff.
षात्वणत्विक: षात्वणत्विक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Relative to the substitution of ष or ण for स and न, (as a rule, &c.)  E. ठक् added to षत्वणत्व as above.
षाध्: षाध्(उ)साधु r. 4th cl. (साध्यति) r. 5th cl. (साध्नोति) 	 1. To effect, to accom-plish or complete. 	 2. To succeed; also साध् ।
षान्त्व्: षान्त्व् r. 10th cl. (सान्त्वयति-ते) To console, to comfort; also सान्त्व् ।
षाष्ठ: षाष्ठ mfn. (-ष्ठः-ष्ठी-ष्ठं) Sixth.  E. षष्ठ the same, and अञ् aff.

षिच्: षिच्(औ)षिचौ r. 6th cl. (सिञ्चति-ते) 	 1. To sprinkle. 	 2. To moisten, to water, (as plants.) 	 3. To pour out. 	 4. To pour in. With अभि prefixed, 1. To anoint, to initiate. 	 2. To sprinkle. With उद्, 1. To sprinkle. 	 2. To make proud. With नि, 1. To pour. 	 2. To im-pregnate. With परि, To pour round.
षिट्: षिट् r. 1st cl. (सेटति) To disregard, to contemn, to despise, to treat with disrespect.
षिड्ग: षिड्ग m. (-ड्गः) 	 1. A catamite. 	 2. A libertine, a lecher. 	 3. A gallant. E. षिट् to despise, Unādi aff. गन् ।
षिध्: षिध् r. 1st cl. (सेधति) To go. (ऊ) षिधू r. 1st cl. (सेधति) 	 1. To command, to order. 	 2. To ordain, especially with respect to holy observances. 3. To do an auspicious act, or one indicating good fortune. 4. To drive off. 	 5. To restrain. 	 6. To interdict. 	 7. To instruct. With अप, To remove. With नि, 1. To remove. 	 2. To prohibit. 3.
